metadata.name: Acid mosaic
metadata.description: One bar of eight stepped cutoff accents, a two-bar moving peak and alternating Q. 1/8-note grid.

metadata.name: Bass portcullis
metadata.description: Sixteen high-pass shutters per bar, four peak positions and half-time Q accents.

metadata.name: Broken telephone
metadata.description: Band-pass syllables on a 1/8 grid, with an offset peak and stuttering resonance width.

metadata.name: Comb lock
metadata.description: Positive comb teeth jump between eight positions while the peak answers every two bars.

metadata.name: Notch code
metadata.description: A sixteen-step spectral barcode. Cutoff, peak and Q each follow a different block sequence.

metadata.name: Ascending stairwell
metadata.description: Eight rising ramps per bar with changing heights; a slow peak climb and inverted Q answer.

metadata.name: Descending teeth
metadata.description: Eight falling band-pass teeth per bar, with rising peak motion and gentle Q steps.

metadata.name: Glass elevator
metadata.description: Two-bar high-pass ascent beneath a falling resonant peak; Q rides a one-bar triangle.

metadata.name: Reverse vacuum
metadata.description: Negative comb suction: four rising/falling cells, slow resonant drift and a narrow Q breath.

metadata.name: Shelf surf
metadata.description: Low-shelf ramps trade warm pulses and lean gaps; moving peak and Q keep the surface alive.

metadata.name: Dotted orbit
metadata.description: Dotted cutoff circles against triplet peak movement and a straight two-bar Q pulse.

metadata.name: Half-time / double-time
metadata.description: A half-speed bass sweep, double-speed stepped peak and straight Q ramps share the main BPM.

metadata.name: Independent city · 93 / 127 BPM
metadata.description: Cutoff follows the main BPM; peak runs at independent 93 BPM and Q at 127 BPM. Deliberate phase drift.

metadata.name: Triplet switchyard
metadata.description: Triplet block cutoffs, dotted falling peak ramps and a straight Q pulse: three interlocking clocks.

metadata.name: Deep current · 0.07 / 0.11 / 0.17 Hz
metadata.description: Three slow independent oscillations turn a steep low-pass into a long, evolving tide.

metadata.name: Flutter engine · 7.3 Hz
metadata.description: Fast cutoff flutter against a 0.23 Hz resonant sweep and 1.7 Hz Q tremor.

metadata.name: Liquid phase · 0.19 / 0.31 Hz
metadata.description: All-pass cascades, counter-running cutoff/peak movement and slow Q drift.

metadata.name: Radio creep · 0.13 / 0.47 Hz
metadata.description: A wandering narrow-band receiver with asymmetrical drift and a slow resonance breath.

metadata.name: Shimmer shelf · 0.41 / 2.9 Hz
metadata.description: High-shelf colour slowly rises and falls while its resonant edge shivers independently.

metadata.name: Alien loom
metadata.description: Negative comb with a fractured 0.37 Hz cutoff, dotted BPM peak blocks and a 1.13 Hz Q drift.

metadata.name: Clockwork reef
metadata.description: A synced comb ramp grows through four heights while two unrelated Hz clocks move the peak and width.

metadata.name: Insect choir
metadata.description: 18.7 Hz fractured band-pass motion, 3.17 Hz peak flutter and slow Q breathing. Deliberately nervous.

metadata.name: Spectral origami
metadata.description: A 16-pole notch folds around stepped BPM cutoff, a 0.43 Hz asymmetric peak and dotted Q movement.

metadata.name: Tidal interference
metadata.description: An independent 83 BPM low-pass tide crosses a main-tempo triplet peak and a slow 0.07 Hz Q current.
